name: HG650
tagline: Modern linear profile with integrated open log storage
description: The HG650 (Upgraded Version) is a premium, heavy-duty wood stove featuring a clean box-style architectural design. Weighing 150kg, it combines a robust structural shell with a generous rectangular viewing glass that delivers exceptional radiant heat. Its distinctive profile includes a large, built-in lower log storage compartment, keeping your fuel dry and accessible, while the front panel features a modernized sliding air-control interface for effortless flame regulation.
features: Substantial 150kg high-mass construction for extended heat retention
Integrated lower compartment providing spacious, open log storage
Widescreen panoramic viewing glass for an uncompromised view of the fire
Upgraded user interface with multi-slot sliding air intake control dials
Straight top flue outlet configuration engineered for powerful draught efficiency
